recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度填滿（packed marrow），由單形性的中到大型芽細胞成片取代，核圓至卵圓、染色質淡、可見核仁，細胞質中等量，正常造血僅剩零星紅系與嗜酸性細胞；抽吸乾抽（dry tap）時要靠切片診斷並做網狀纖維染色。
features: Packed, 100% cellular marrow with sheets of immature cells
Medium to large blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine vesicular chromatin and small distinct nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale amphophilic cytoplasm with discernible cell borders
Scant residual erythroid precursors and eosinophils; mature megakaryocytes not conspicuous in this field
Scattered mitotic figures; fibrosis cannot be assessed on H&E alone
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is packed and essentially 100% cellular, composed of sheets of medium to large blasts with round to oval nuclei, fine vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm. Residual hematopoiesis is limited to scattered erythroid precursors and eosinophils, and mature megakaryocytes are not conspicuous. Occasional mitotic figures are present. Given the dry tap, reticulin staining and immunohistochemistry (CD61, CD42b, CD34) are warranted; findings are consistent with acute megakaryoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: APMF shows trilineage proliferation with dysplastic megakaryocytes and marked fibrosis rather than a monotonous blast sheet.
PMF has clustered atypical mature megakaryocytes, osteosclerosis and prior MPN history with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by lymphoma or metastatic tumor
ddx.vs: Immunohistochemistry (CD45, lymphoid, keratin, CD61) distinguishes non-myeloid infiltrates, which can also cause a dry tap.
